slot.intent: Three banks, two funds and one regulator were involved, and nobody asked a single question.

concept: A list that counts down to nothing: each item builds as it is named, one square marker glides down a hairline spine to meet it, the named items step back, and the last lands red.
storyboard: 0.0 s, on "Three": the first item builds word by word in heavy sentence case, grey settling to off white, and a small solid off-white square fades in at its left
1.4 s: the square glides down to the second place, drawing a hairline spine behind it, and arrives as "two" is spoken at 1.75 s; Three banks steps back to mid grey
3.1 s: the square glides on to the third place for "one regulator" at 3.5 s, the spine following; Three banks steps back again to pale grey, two funds to mid grey
4.85 s: the square glides to the last place, arriving as "no" is spoken at 5.25 s, and turns red as it lands
6.1 s, on "questions.": the word lands as a flat red highlighter sweeps behind No questions in the same stroke, landing at 6.5 s
Then a full hold to the end: the walked spine and the earlier items quiet in grey, only No questions bright and marked; the camera never moves

leansOn.title: Progress steps (this channel's approved version)
leansOn.why: One trail walks the steps as each is named, walked steps fade back to grey in stages, and the landing step turns red with a highlighter behind it.
